answer: By the signal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the tundra until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the ledge of the next round. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
